newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit raises stake in PRC JV.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit raises stake in PRC JV.

text.p: Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd will increase its stake in a PRC joint venture air conditioner manufacturer by taking a share of the JV partner's holding after an internal transfer, the company said.

In an announcement published on Tuesday, the company said its wholly owned subsidiary Leading Spirit Electronics Ltd (LSE) and Jiangmen Pengjiang Electronics Factory, a PRC-based collectively owned enterprise, have agreed to sell stakes in Jiangmen Dongling Air-Coner Ltd to Watarah International Ltd, another wholly-owned Leading Spirit subsidiary.

LSE is transferring its entire 70 percent stake in the joint venture, a transaction worth US$3.43 million (HK$26.5 million), it said. Watarah will also acquire a 21 percent interest from Jiangmen Pengjiang Electronics for HK$7.09 million, further increasing its stake in Dongling to 91 percent.
Jiangmen Pengjiang's interest in the joint venture will fall to 9.0 percent.
The value was calculated considering the JV's audited net asset worth at June 30, 1996, of 31.34 million yuan or HK$33.75 million.
The transactions are to expected to be completed by January 31, 1997. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6933
